payload.refined_catalog_yaml:
id: gitboard
scope:
    modules:
        - .
slices:
    - id: board
      objective: Provides JSON data structures used by the dashboard and other components.
      owns:
        - id: internal-board
          path: internal/board
          layer: domain
    - id: cliexec
      objective: Executes external processes using the os/exec package.
      owns:
        - id: internal-cliexec
          path: internal/cliexec
          layer: domain
    - id: dashboard
      objective: Aggregates views for the dashboard.
      owns:
        - id: internal-dashboard
          path: internal/dashboard
          layer: domain
    - id: gitboard
      objective: A local code-change board for GitLab and GitHub.
      surfaces:
        - id: gitboard-cli
          kind: cli
          components:
            - id: cmd-gitboard
              path: cmd/gitboard
    - id: llm
      objective: Provides an OpenAI-compatible chat completions client by adapting external API responses.
      owns:
        - id: internal-llm
          path: internal/llm
          layer: domain
    - id: localgit
      objective: Provides git operations and metadata enrichment for local repositories.
      owns:
        - id: internal-localgit
          path: internal/localgit
          layer: domain
    - id: observability
      objective: Initializes OpenTelemetry tracing and manages error-only inference dumps.
      owns:
        - id: internal-observability
          path: internal/observability
          layer: domain
    - id: pruneagent
      objective: Investigate local-only or likely-removable branches.
      owns:
        - id: internal-pruneagent
          path: internal/pruneagent
          layer: domain
    - id: remotegit
      objective: Provides adapters to interact with remote git services such as GitHub and GitLab.
      owns:
        - id: internal-remotegit
          path: internal/remotegit
          layer: domain
    - id: server
      objective: Provides HTTP serving capabilities and wires request handlers.
      surfaces:
        - id: server-ui
          kind: ui
          components:
            - id: internal-server
              path: internal/server
    - id: syncproj
      objective: Aggregates project selection and discovery information.
      owns:
        - id: internal-syncproj
          path: internal/syncproj
          layer: domain
    - id: triage
      objective: Analyzes project logs and job information to produce a summary and root cause analysis.
      owns:
        - id: internal-triage
          path: internal/triage
          layer: domain
libraries:
    - id: config
      purpose: Shared technical package without domain knowledge
      owns:
        - id: internal-config
          path: internal/config
          layer: domain
sliceBindings:
    - from: remotegit
      to: board
      kind: reads
    - from: remotegit
      to: cliexec
      kind: reads
    - from: remotegit
      to: config
      kind: reads
    - from: server
      to: config
      kind: reads
    - from: server
      to: dashboard
      kind: reads
    - from: server
      to: pruneagent
      kind: reads
    - from: server
      to: triage
      kind: reads
    - from: syncproj
      to: config
      kind: reads
    - from: syncproj
      to: remotegit
      kind: reads
    - from: triage
      to: config
      kind: reads
    - from: triage
      to: llm
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: cliexec
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: config
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: dashboard
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: llm
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: localgit
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: observability
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: pruneagent
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: remotegit
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: server
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: syncproj
      kind: reads
    - from: gitboard
      to: triage
      kind: reads
    - from: dashboard
      to: board
      kind: reads
    - from: dashboard
      to: config
      kind: reads
    - from: dashboard
      to: localgit
      kind: reads
    - from: dashboard
      to: remotegit
      kind: reads
    - from: llm
      to: config
      kind: reads
    - from: pruneagent
      to: cliexec
      kind: reads
    - from: pruneagent
      to: llm
      kind: reads
    - from: pruneagent
      to: localgit
      kind: reads
    - from: localgit
      to: cliexec
      kind: reads
